__rule__: D10 (a document is a :Source) — the per-document TOPOLOGY, IDENTITY and VERSION facts. ⚠️ The Q-S2 `documents`-cap predicate ruling is SUPERSEDED: the owner's cost-model direction (2026-09-25, #5013 → #5332) makes a document NOT a cost unit — storage is metered as Postgres MB/GB + graph MB + extraction ops, sold as overage. There is no documents-cap predicate, and this fixture asserts none.

The declared shapes cannot be exercised as a contrast set against live data: the live graph was measured all-`agentSession` (2,208 rows, 2026-09-24 — the population the retired cap ruling was measured over). A constructed population is the only way to MEASURE the topology, identity and axis facts rather than merely declare them. ⚠️ This fixture no longer carries a `documents`-cap predicate, a per-row cap verdict, or any `REJECTED_*` candidate: that model is retired (#5332) and the fixture must not re-assert it.

why_this_case: the ordinary document-bearing :Source — a file of raw data referenced by a :Source (D10), identified by its url. The genre axis (documentKind) is populated here and absent in doc-without-genre: the pair is what makes the axis measurable rather than assumed.

the same shape with NO genre — documentKind is NULL. This is the contrast case for the genre axis: documentKind is a GENRE, not a source kind (Q2), so its absence must not change the node's identity, label or replay key. ⚠️ This row USED to be the retired cap's 'leak case'; the cap model is superseded (#5332) and the row is kept for the axis contrast.

the live production shape (all 2,208 rows measured 2026-09-24 were agentSession). Same topology and identity as a document — :Source, keyed by url — which is the D10 claim that the entity layer is uniform over documents, code and transcripts.

why_this_case: the agentSession shape carrying documentKind='transcript': the genre axis and the source kind are INDEPENDENT (Q2) — a session can carry a genre without becoming a document kind. The §4.4 pack vocabulary keeps the two axes disjoint.
re-ingesting identical content must be a no-op — one node, version unchanged, no new facts. This is the property the round-trip/integration layer must hold (test_idempotent_rerun).

why_this_case: a changed source bumps version by 1 (never replaces the node) and its already-derived entities become stale IMMEDIATELY; they are superseded only when re-inference produces successors. stale != wrong. The graph shows the CURRENT version; the history lives in the journal.
